necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, dizziness, and near-syncope that are intermittent and difficult to capture on standard ambulatory monitoring. Given the clinical suspicion of sick sinus syndrome and unspecified cardiac arrhythmia (I49.5), prolonged mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is medically necessary to correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended period.
